description: Elevation Aotearoa is the web application of the National Elevation Programme run by Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ), which provides LiDAR-based elevation data for most of the country. The site read on 2026-09-28 has two maps, LiDAR availability with its release schedule and LiDAR age, and explains that digital elevation models (DEM), digital surface models (DSM) and point clouds are available through the LINZ Data Service, with links in each area's attributes; areas are marked as available, in progress or planned, and guides for open source and Esri tools and case studies are included. Coverage is national, region by region, at LiDAR resolution (typically 1 m grids). Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 unless otherwise specified (LINZ copyright page). Access is free of charge. Caveats: survey years differ between regions, some areas are still in progress, and the viewer itself holds status, not the elevation data. It serves hazard exposure analysis for flooding, coastal inundation and landslides and climate adaptation planning of roads, water networks and buildings in New Zealand. Related record: data-linz-nz-building-outlines is another LINZ national layer often combined with the elevation models.
